description: This is an abstract Java class named `AbstractController` providing common web controller functionalities such as session management, exception handling, and pagination setup for a Spring MVC web application.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: An abstract base class for Spring MVC controllers defining common behaviors and utilities for session management, exception handling, and pagination.

methods.name: getSessionAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute of a generic type associated with a specified key from the HTTP session.

methods.name: setSessionAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute with a given key and value in the HTTP session.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute identified by the key from the HTTP session.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the Language object stored in the request attributes.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown within the controller, rendering appropriate error views based on exception type.

methods.name: createPaginaionData
methods.description: Creates a PaginationData object based on page number and size.

methods.name: calculatePaginaionData
methods.description: Updates the PaginationData object with total result count.
